observation_summary: The method DateUtils.isSameLocalTime incorrectly compares times by using Calendar.HOUR instead of Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, leading to false positives when comparing times across the AM/PM boundary.
reasoning_summary: The bug is a procedural error in the comparison logic. The method uses the wrong field (12-hour format) to compare time, which is a computational logic error. It is not a missing guard (Checking), a wrong constant (Assignment), or a design-level capability issue (Function/Class/Object).
evidence_used: The bug report explicitly states: 'This is because the method compares cal1.get(Calendar.HOUR) == cal2.get(Calendar.HOUR) but I think it has to be cal1.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY) == cal2.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY)'

alternative_types.why_not_primary: The issue is not an incorrect value or initialization, but the use of an incorrect field in a comparison algorithm.
The issue is not a missing or incorrect guard/validation, but the logic within the comparison itself.
